prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / style-transfer. This is the ONE final correction to a medieval RPG portrait, using independent visual QA. Image 1 is the current portrait to redraw; images 2–5 are Mara, Iwo, Leiya, Tore STYLE examples only. Preserve image 1's identity; CHANGE its overlong neck, overly broad eye whites, busy texture and excess torso.

CRITICAL DRAWING CHANGE: Draw a close, large HEAD portrait, not a bust. The lower jaw almost touches the narrow collar. Remove approximately two thirds of the current visible neck length and ALL deep V-neck/chest space by actually redrawing the neck/collar. Move the garment UP to the jaw. Do not merely rescale the entire old picture, because that keeps the wrong long-neck geometry. There should be a large face and a tiny garment strip. Follow the short-neck proportions of images 2–5 exactly.

CRITICAL EYES: Both eye openings are small dark narrow slits tucked under lids. Remove the big white polygons completely; sclera is a tiny muted brown-gray sliver of at most ONE logical pixel per eye, no white color anywhere inside either eye. The face should not have a white-eyed/anime stare.

CRITICAL PIXEL STYLE: Coarse low-resolution 74x100 logical pixel-art portrait, shown as a clean nearest-neighbor enlarged image if necessary. Solid square stepped color clusters and visibly large angular nose / cheekbone planes; only 3–4 broad skin color regions plus tiny accents, only 3 hair shades, at most 32 flat visible colors overall. Consolidate small speckles and thin stripe details into broad connected masses. No smooth shading, gradients, antialiasing, painterly high-resolution texture, dithering, or microdetail. Core style references show the required strong flat face construction.

Identity: Madi, a woman around fifty. Keep her long narrow mature face, prominent long nose, gray streaks in dark hair, tied pale oatmeal headcloth and complete compact rear knot, warm weathered skin, charcoal inn smock and rusty-brown inner collar. Preserve mature drooping eyelids and mouth folds. Calm worried but firm, a compressed downturned closed mouth, not frightened: flatten and lower the raised middle of the eyebrows. No beauty makeover. The pale headcloth must remain but be compact enough to make the face larger. Move the entire crown upward into the unused top area and make the face fill this canvas, with crown around logical y=3, lower chin around y=85. Bare neck only 3–4 logical pixels, shoulders/collar only y=89–97. Gray hair and both visible ear contours and whole headcloth knot must remain complete.

Canvas aspect 74:100. All hair, ears, headcloth if present and clothing must end naturally inside the SOURCE frame, with genuine transparent margins about 3 logical pixels each side and above and 2 below; do not clip then pad. Transparent background. Single portrait only, no scene, hands, props, text, swatches, frames or labels. Preserve all identity and clothing colors unless specifically corrected above.
